summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found by reading the code (no changes made):**  The backend path is actually solid: `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware that validates the session cookie/token, looks up the user via `getSession()`, and injects `X-User-Id`. Every route (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /:id/items`, `DELETE /:id/items/:itemId`) filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, so ownership scoping looks correct. `login()` in `db/auth.ts` looks the user up by email and reuses the same `user_id` across sessions — I didn't find a hardcoded
